fields.summary_ko.0: TD Cowen downgraded Marvell (MRVL) investment rating from 'Buy' to 'Hold' and cut target price by 50% from $350 to $175.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lumentum (LITE) acquisition raises first-year EPS dilution concerns, and questions about market cycle timing suggest lower near-term and medium-term stock appreciation potential.
fields.summary_ko.2: MRVL rose nearly 2x YTD and LITE gained over 75%, but following the acquisition announcement, they fell 12% and 18.5% respectively, reflecting investor concerns.
